messages:
deploy-bot: Canary deployment started for service `inference-runtime` in env `prod-usw2`

deploy details: commit `a1b2c3d6` tag `v2.4.1-canary`.
link: https://deploy.redwood.internal/ops/1998876543

sasha: Noted. Observability hooks armed. I'll watch p99 latency and 5xx.

mike: Rolling 5% traffic to canary now.

deploy-bot: Traffic split updated: baseline 95% -> canary 5%.

oncall-bot: CPU on inference-runtime/canary pod 1 spiked to 78% at 12:07 UTC (short spike), no error increase.

eva: Seeing small p95 increase on embedding route, still within SLOs. Keeping an eye.

sasha: Suggest pinning model to `gpt-open-3b@2026-03-20` for this canary run to avoid accidental variant drift.

mike: Done — pinned to `gpt-open-3b@2026-03-20` in rollout config.

deploy-bot: Canary traffic expanded to 25% after 10m.

oncall-bot: Metric check — errors: +0.2% (baseline 0.8% -> 1.0%), latency p95 +40ms. No deploy-blocking alerts.

sasha: Agree to promote if stable for another 20m. If errors >1.5% roll back.

mike: Noted, will monitor. ETA for full promote ~35m.

eva: Running quick smoke tests (reranking + embeddings). All green.

deploy-bot: Canary run complete. Health gates passed: traffic 25% for 20m, error rate within threshold, autoscale healthy.

mike: Promoting to 100% now. Tagging release `v2.4.1` (from `v2.4.1-canary`).

deploy-bot: Promotion started — traffic split baseline 0 -> prior canary.

deploy-bot: Promotion finished. Service `inference-runtime` now serving `v2.4.1` in `prod-usw2`.

sasha: Good run. I'll update release notes with the following changelog:
- improved KV cache handling for summarization flows
- quantization fallback for small models

mike: I'll pin the rollout in the console and add a short blurb to the release channel.

eva: Thx all. If anything regresses ping #oncall immediately.

mike: Release done. :tada:
